# OSCAR Type-I Enriques lattice datum

The pinned OSCAR 1.4.0 datum is
`TauTaubarGenericEnriquesSurfaceNo172.mrdi` for `generic_enriques_surface(172)`.
[Upstream data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oscar-system/Oscar.jl/v1.4.0/data/TauTaubarGenericEnriquesSurfaces/TauTaubarGenericEnriquesSurfaceNo172.mrdi)
· [Loader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oscar-system/Oscar.jl/v1.4.0/src/AlgebraicGeometry/Surfaces/EnriquesAut.jl).

The loader assigns `SY,SX,L26,w,u`; the fourth object is the Weyl vector.
The loader's SHA-256 is `48cebfc2e924b914bfdc4d4d4f9d430a06439f8af35b798c8f7a556395989924`.
The upstream datum hashes to
`73e8e8612a9223156fb6024c62d51b32dc8a739ec9cd1cb09129a65acb73caa1`;
the local copy adds one terminal newline. The two byte forms are distinguished.

This is a lattice/Borcherds context, not surface equations. The OSCAR
description gives rank 19 and determinant 4. Geometric existence and the
12A chamber identification use Brandhorst–Shimada, Section 7.4. The upstream package is [GPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/oscar-system/Oscar.jl/blob/v1.4.0/LICENSE.md);
this repository grants no new rights to third-party inputs.
